content:
emma_engineer: Hi team — saw extra state tax on my April stub: 4% NJ withholding even though I live in NY and worked from our NYC office all month. Gross seems right but net is down ~$290. Anyone know why?

ryan_payroll: Thanks for reporting, Emma. Can you paste the redacted stub lines? Also did you travel to NJ in March/April at all? Multi-state withholdings often come from a residence vs work-state flag mismatch or a temporary remote tag.

emma_engineer: Stub excerpt:

Gross: $7,250.00
Federal: $1,450.00
FICA: $555.00
NY state: $290.00
NJ state: $290.00
Net: $4,665.00

nina_hr: I checked HRIS — your primary residence is NY but a short project entry logged you as "temporary NJ" for one week in March. That flag sometimes persists until HR closes the assignment. I'll clear it now.

mark_finance: Note: W-2s can carry multiple state boxes (Box 15/16) if wages were allocated. If NJ withholding was applied in error, payroll can run an off-cycle reversal; if NJ already received remittance we may need to coordinate a refund.

ryan_payroll: I'll open an adjustment ticket (PR-ADJ-8810). If remittance not sent, we can reverse within 5 business days. If remitted, we'll request a refund and provide guidance for you to claim on your NJ nonresident return. Either way we'll correct the payroll records so your year-end W-2 reflects NY only.

emma_engineer: Do I need to file any forms now? I haven't filed NJ nonresident returns for this year.

ryan_payroll: No immediate action required. If withholding stays and we can't recover cash before filing deadlines, we'll give you docs to support a refund claim on NJ Form NJ-1040NR and coordinate with tax counsel. Also please sign the residency affidavit I'll DM to confirm NY domicile.

nina_hr: I'll update the HR checklist to close temporary location flags automatically after 7 days to avoid this recurring.

payroll-bot: PR-ADJ-8810 created and assigned to ryan_payroll. Estimated resolution: 2026-04-12.

emma_engineer: Thank you — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll sign the affidavit when it arrives. :thumbsup:
